$comment: Blind rater AC, seed 1501, production build on :5230 (commit fba365b), headed GPU driver 400x800 @3x. Read only eval/RATING.md, docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, eval-fun FRAMEWORK.md sections 1-3, the template (and the header of tools/driver.mjs for driver ops). Did not open PLAN.md, research/, docs/CUT*.md, other cards or source. Absence was simulated (?dev=1&absent=8h), not a real wall-clock absence; return was scored in the same sitting. Notes: scratchpad/raterAC/notes.md.

absences: 8h simulated via ?dev=1&absent=8h (not a real wall-clock absence)
horizon.note: 36 min cold (12 sends: 8 at 1x, 3 'fights', 1 'fast'), then the 8h absence, then 18 min on return (6 sends: 2 at 1x, 3 'fights', 1 'fast', 1 skip). Deaths read in full: 5 (4 watched + 1 offline). 15 of my own rule edits plus 1 applied patch. Audio fired (window.__audio.log, 1323 cues, unmuted) but I could not hear it: unassessed.

criterion.delayedRecall: same-day: The den on D6 woke and thieves snatched my leash and teleport scroll, bloats on D7 gassed him down to a few HP, and he went into the Goblin Warlord with no potion left ('drink ✗ no item'). He broke the Warlord anyway ('WARLORD BREAKS' → 'GOBLIN WARLORD DOWN'), walked into the Fens on D9 for the first time, met a pink jelly, and my depth rule banked $133. It was the run where the 'on see den → descend' and 'foe: boss' rows I had written after the overnight report paid off, and it unlocked the ranger.

probes.clarity: Did you ever not know what to do, or what just happened? — What happened was always readable (the morgue line 'R1 unknown item' on every tick told me my heal was unidentified), but money was not: the HUD said 'carry $78 · keeps $78 · bank R4' and he then died with '$0', and a patch promising 'reach D7 +20%' turned into 'D7 0%' in the camp forecast once applied.
probes.decisions: Name a choice you made and why. — I set 'loot ≥ 100 → bank' instead of 50 because the forecast showed '~$57, bank 55%' against '~$45, bank 87%', and I'd make it again; later 'stairs seen → descend' traded money for depth ('~$93' but D6 78%).
probes.mastery: What can you do now that you couldn't an hour ago? — The first heir died at D5 ('Trophy: no heal to D5'); by the end I bank at D10 every run and kill the Warlord with a 'foe: boss → attack boss' row, because I learned heal is 'violet', thieves live in dens, and bank must sit above retreat.
probes.tension: Where did you sweat? — Run 2 died with '$73 carried' 27 short of my own 'loot ≥ 100' bank threshold, and the first Warlord came with 'drink ✗ no item'; after the absence 15 of 16 runs banked, so later runs rarely felt at risk.
probes.feel: What did you actually see? — Readable callouts every ~3 s at 1x ('POPS!', 'WARLORD BREAKS', 'The den wakes: thieves on every side.'), but 'fast' took 127 s for a run 'fights' did in 104–156 s, and one Warlord fight showed ~25 s of 'stalling' and 'hit ✗ no target'.
probes.surprise: What directly surprised you and changed your decisions? — Monkeys stealing a scroll I hadn't identified, a 'fire' potion drunk by my own gamble row at 8 HP, bloats bursting, a cage 'three inside, one to take', the Fens tileset; each changed a rule, though monkey theft then happened in nearly every run.
probes.expression: Describe your build to a friend. — A cautious banker that drinks heal at 30%, banks at 30% or at D10 below half, walks past any den it sees, dives when it sees stairs, and hits the boss first; recognisably mine, but sets 2 and 3 stayed empty and the patches pull toward the same shape.
probes.story: Tell me about one run. — See delayedRecall: den thieves took everything, bloats gassed him, he broke the Warlord potionless and banked in the Fens.
probes.pacing: Where did play drag, where did administration delay? — A run is 40–150 s at 1x and a check-in is a minute; the drag is 'fast' barely being faster and the boss stall; the skip button (whole run in ~10 s) is the real fast-forward.
probes.failure: Why did you lose? Whose fault was it? — 'BURST · D6 · R1 DRINK UNKNOWN', stamp ROW, '1 hp short', 'The smoky one: fire. Gambled: fire potion.' — my own gamble row killed him and the screen said so, with three patches and their 'survives %' below.
probes.social: n/a — solo; heirs finding each other's bones ('Found heir 2's bones: 6 items') is story, not relationship.
probes.autonomy: What did you decide to do that the game didn't ask for? — I chose to avoid dens and to hunt the D9 Warlord shown as 'D9 · warlord 0%' in the forecast; the dungeon order itself is fixed and descent is linear.
probes.progression: What grew, what persisted? — Rows 2→8, verbs (throw, cleave, attack boss), classes (rogue, ranger after 'slay a boss'), fighter L1→L4, ledger SEEN/KNOWN/STUDIED columns, ★1→7, $0→$3306; +1 row escalated ◆2→4→7→11 and the fresh ranger L1 forecast 'death 54%', so the new class was not usable yet.
probes.aesthetic: Describe the place. — Painted camp header of the hero on stairs, pixel dungeon with a warm burrows palette that turns teal in the Fens, torn red death banners with a wax 'ROW'/'GAP' seal; camp below the rules is a large empty dark area and the header never changed.
probes.return: What did you come back to, what did you decide? — '16 RUNS · 15 BANKED · 1 DEATH', '+$2028 banked', 'PLATEAU R2 bank ended 7 runs, none past D8', 'R5 fired 0 of 16 runs: foes ≥ 3 → drink strength', and 'goblin warlord · counter: attack boss'; I cut the dead strength row, wrote a boss row and a den row, bought a row, and got D9 then D10 within two runs. I would not rather have stayed.
probes.attribution: Tell me how the last run ended. Whose decision was that? — 'My R3 banked him at D10 after he broke the Warlord with my R7 attack boss'; my words were 'my rule killed him' for the fire-potion death, but the D5 death where the patch's retreat fired ten times in a row was stamped GAP, which felt like the game's fault, not mine.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Every tick of the trace names why each row did not fire ('R1 unknown item', 'R3 foes appeared after', 'R1 hazard first · gas'). Named lapse: the money/forecast layer does not reconcile — 'carry $78 · keeps $78 · bank R4' then 'died $0'; a patch showing 'reach D7 +20%' became 'D7 0%' in camp; heir number rose after a bank with no explanation; 'repeat · $80' was charged on death without my noticing.

'loot ≥ 50 → bank' forecast 'bank 87% ~$45 D5 2%' versus '≥ 100' 'bank 55% ~$57 D6 16%' — two defensible choices before sending. Named lapse: once heal potions went on sale, 'hp < 30% → drink heal' plus a heal in the loadout was strictly dominant (forecast ~$52 → ~$108), and the fresh ranger was strictly worse than fighter L4.

Deepest bank D5 → D6 → D7 → D9 → D10 in the horizon, each step from something I learned ('heal (violet)', thieves in dens, bank above retreat, 'counter: attack boss'). Named lapse: after the Warlord fell, edits moved the forecast only a few points ('~$123 → ~$130') and the next thing to learn was not visible.

Early stakes were real: 'died $0 · $73 carried' 27 short of my own bank threshold; first Warlord with 'drink ✗ no item'. After the absence '15 BANKED · 1 DEATH' and every return-session run banked, so the push-or-bank tension faded.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: At 1x a new line or callout lands about every 3 s ('POPS!', 'WARLORD BREAKS', 'The monkey stole the ashen scroll?'); smooth headed. But 'fast' took 127 s for a run (1x runs 40–90 s), and one Warlord fight had ~25 s of 'stalling'/'hit ✗ no target'. Audio unassessed (cues logged, not heard).

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Monkeys stealing unidentified scrolls, 'The smoky one: fire.' from my own gamble, bloats bursting, cages, captives ('Cut the captive down.'), the Warlord, the Fens and eels; each changed a rule. Named lapse: monkey/den theft happened in almost every run ('The monkey stole the invisibility potion.' three times) and became a tax, not a surprise.

My final 8 rows ('on see den → descend', 'hp < 50% · depth ≥ 10 → bank', 'foe: boss → attack boss') read as my own cautious banker. But sets 2/3 stayed at 0, rows get tagged by the game ('gambler'), and the class choice was not a real choice.

Best run has a clear turn (thieves strip him, bloats gas him, he breaks the Warlord potionless, banks in the Fens); the chronicle keeps lines like '♟3 the brave fighter · D6 · found ♟2's bones · fell to gas'. Named lapse: return-session runs retell the same Warlord beat ('Slew the Goblin Warlord.') four times.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: In-play: 40–150 s runs, lines every ~3 s, one ~25 s boss stall; 'fast' barely faster, skip (~10 s) works. Administrative: death → patch → camp → send is under a minute, but the unlocks sheet reflowed under my finger twice (opened 'cond: turns' when aiming at '+1 row').

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: 'BURST · D6 · R1 DRINK UNKNOWN' + ROW + '1 hp short' + three patches with 'survives 92% · base 17%' and a DROP sheet showing each row's fire count ('R4 98/99, R3 0/99'). Named lapse: the patch I applied ('hp < 40% · foes ≥ 2 → retreat', 'survives 92%') retreated ten ticks straight from fast jackals into death, and that death was stamped GAP, not the patch's row.
I set my own goals from 'D9 · warlord 0%' and from avoiding dens; rules let me dive or loot. The dungeon is a linear descent and the goals on offer are the ones the forecast shows.

Within-run: kit from cages, loot, depth. Persistent: rows 2→8, verbs/conds (throw, loot, alert, cleave, attack boss), rogue/ranger, fighter L4, ledger columns, cards, ★7, vault/forge. Named lapse: +1 row cost ◆2→4→7→11 and ranger L1 forecast 'death 54%' against fighter L4's 10%, so the headline unlock was unusable in the horizon.

Painted camp header, pixel burrows turning to teal Fens, red death banners with wax 'ROW'/'GAP' seals. Named lapse: the camp's lower half is an empty dark field and the header art never changed across the hour. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: offline yield vs active; decisions pending on return
axes.note: '16 RUNS · 15 BANKED · 1 DEATH', '+$2028 banked', 'PLATEAU R2 bank ended 7 runs, none past D8', 'R5 fired 0 of 16 runs', 'goblin warlord · counter: attack boss' → I cut a dead row, wrote boss and den rows and hit D9/D10 within two runs. About $250/h offline vs roughly $600–800/h while I was actively editing. Named lapse: offline almost never loses, so the report is a list of wins with one death; 8 runs collapse into '· 8 earlier'.

axes.proxy: share of deaths attributable to a rule the player wrote
axes.note: I say 'my R1 drank the fire potion' and 'my R7 attack boss broke him' (the caption showed 'R7 · attack boss'). Named lapse: a patch I applied caused a death stamped GAP, and the Warlord kill in my best run was captioned 'R8 · attack nearest', not my boss row — ownership blurred there.

gripes: Thieves (monkeys/dens) steal the $40 potions I buy in nearly every run — invisibility three times, heal four — and 'attack thief' or 'on see den → descend' only partly helps; it feels like a tax, not a puzzle.
The money layer doesn't add up to me: 'keeps $78' then died $0; loadout 'repeat' charged on death; a patch's 'reach D7 +20%' became D7 0% in camp; heir numbers change for reasons I never saw.
Speeds: 'fast' is barely faster than 1x, and one boss fight stalled ~25 s; after the absence nearly every run banks, so the later hour has less at stake.
tellAFriend: You write eight if-then rules and the hero plays by them; when he dies the banner names the exact row that killed him ('R1 DRINK UNKNOWN', '1 hp short') and offers fixes with survival odds.
The forecast column updates as you edit, so you can see '~$45 safe' against '~$57 greedy' before you send him.
The overnight report tells you which rows never fired and what the boss is weak to; I fixed three rows and beat the Warlord two runs later.
